description: This script is a test suite for Git's handling of CRLF (Carriage Return and Line Feed) conversions, focusing on the autocrlf and safecrlf configurations. It contains test cases that execute Git commands, manipulate files, and verify correct behavior when dealing with different line ending scenarios, including the use of gitattributes and patch applications.

methods.name: has_cr
methods.description: Checks if the given file contains CR (Carriage Return, ASCII 13) characters.

methods.name: munge_cr
methods.description: Adds or removes CR characters from a file in-place based on specified operation.

methods.name: cr_to_Q_no_NL
methods.description: Converts CR characters to 'Q' and removes newline characters, used for testing line endings.
